## Truthful gaps

- **Ambient/contact shading:** The existing screen-space contact effect belongs to the isolated WebGL2 compatibility post path. It is not exposed until a TSL depth implementation passes parity and performance gates.
- **Frame-rate cap:** The UI must not describe target FPS as a hard cap. A cap requires a dedicated frame scheduler and timing verification.
- **Hardware ray tracing:** The RTX 5080 is the review GPU, but the current renderer does not implement hardware ray tracing. No RTX-specific ray-tracing claim or toggle is permitted.
